nameZh: 早餐果蔬奶昔（USDA 页面收录）
license: Ingredient facts and original Chinese paraphrase; no source photo included; credited partner recipe, not a USDA-authored recipe

ingredients.originalText: 1 cup milk (low fat or fat free)

ingredients.conversionBasis: FDC 173950, 1 cup unthawed unsweetened blueberries = 155g; selected source-permitted fruit variant

ingredients.originalText: 2 tablespoons peanut butter (or sunflower seed butter)
ingredients.conversionBasis: FDC 172470: portion amount 2 tbsp = 32g; selected peanut butter variant
One handful interpreted as approximately one loose cup; FDC cup = 30g, review actual amount

steps: 先清洗双手、香蕉及菠菜等原料。
剥好香蕉并切片，将所有材料放入搅拌机。
搅打成均匀奶昔，分成两份后食用。
notes: 保留原方的 2 份产量。按所选 USDA 食材重新计算营养；一把菠菜的克数为明确估算，未引用原站图片或宣称原方营养已验证。
